result.summary: The 2019 page drops the 2018 'respect and value employees from every background' and 'communicate openly with our customers' values and the 'Growth' heading, adding an 'Ohana' guided-by-values framing, a privacy-of-customer-data emphasis, and a 'Customer Success' section with an 'Ensuring that all voices are welcome and heard' commitment. Shifts emphasis toward customers and inclusion wording, with a pivot to 'sales revenues' language.
